searchText: Hello everybody, I designed a copyright protection system that currently uses the Tokyo cabinet database. I want to design a database based on blockchain to store hashes. Do you have any suggestion? can I use IPFS or Storj? (my code is based on .net) You probably don't want a blockchain for data storage. IPFS or BitTorrent tend to be better solutions for that. That being said, this is better suited for <#595721451651465227>. Also, you are likely to not find a lot of help with copyright protection from the open source community. 😉 That's right, thanks
